##### PASTE FROM HERE: dev-juniper-synthetic-inherit #####
configure exclusive
# roles: the login classes tacctl renders (every leaf of a rendered class, allow-*/deny-* included)
set system login class RO-CLASS permissions network
set system login class RO-CLASS permissions view
set system login class RO-CLASS permissions view-configuration
set system login user RO-CLASS class RO-CLASS
set system login class OP-CLASS permissions network
set system login class OP-CLASS permissions trace
set system login class OP-CLASS permissions view
set system login class OP-CLASS permissions view-configuration
set system login user OP-CLASS class OP-CLASS
set system login class RW-CLASS permissions all
set system login user RW-CLASS class RW-CLASS
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions view
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions view-configuration
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions network
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions clear
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions trace
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions reset
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions configure
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions rollback
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions interface
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions interface-control
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions routing
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions routing-control
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions firewall
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions firewall-control
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions system
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions system-control
set system login class EN-CLASS permissions snmp
set system login user EN-CLASS class EN-CLASS
# snmp: the client list tacctl renders
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 192.0.2.10/32
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 198.51.100.0/24
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 0.0.0.0/0 restrict
set snmp community lab-ro-community authorization read-only
set snmp community lab-ro-community client-list-name TACCTL-SNMP
set snmp location "Rack 4, DC1"
set snmp contact "NOC <noc@example.net>"
set snmp description "Core switch"
# mgmt-acl: the management filter tacctl renders (its terms, their leaves and their order)
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.10/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from destination-port 830
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from destination-port ssh
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from destination-port 830
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then discard
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 192.0.2.10/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then discard
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term default-accept then accept
show | compare | no-more
commit check
commit confirmed 5 comment "tacctl plan dev-juniper-synthetic-inherit 2026-10-10T14:20Z by alice"

# Then type exit: the session holds the configuration lock until you do.

# If your session drops before that, the switch still rolls back when the time runs out (a dropped
# CLI session does not roll back at once): log in again and paste again.
# To undo it after the commit: tacctl device config plan dev-juniper-synthetic-inherit --backout
# (its own region to paste; tacctl keeps this plan's back-out: after the check pull has replaced
# the picture, the command still prints this plan's, and says which pull it undoes, until the next
# plan with changes). Without tacctl: show system commit, then rollback <n> of the entry just
# before the one commented "tacctl plan dev-juniper-synthetic-inherit" (the newest entry is that
# commit itself), then commit.

# another device; keep this output in a file after the paste when it holds a secret.
# Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold dev-juniper-synthetic-inherit --reason "..."
